name: Queue
label: Redis / memory queue
description: Enqueue, dequeue, peek, length against Redis RESP or a bounded in-memory backend. memory is lab / single-replica only. listen is ingress (broker consume is not a StudioQuack Webhook node). AMQP is the rabbitmq node, not a backend here. Handler: QueueNode.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Queue operation. Input wins over config. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. Example operation: 'enqueue'.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: enqueue | dequeue | peek | length | listen. listen is ingress.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Payload for enqueue. Strings/numbers/booleans sent as-is; objects as JSON.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result as JSON (`status`/`data`). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Operation payload (parsed JSON or engine result). Absent when unused.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: HTTP status when the op is an official HTTP call. Absent for in-process ops.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Which capability to run. EXACT accepted values: enqueue | dequeue | peek | length | listen. listen is ingress. Required. Example: 'enqueue'.

configurationParameters.label: Backend
configurationParameters.description: redis | memory. memory is lab / single-replica only. For AMQP use the rabbitmq node.

configurationParameters.label: Url
configurationParameters.description: redis:// or rediss:// URL (prefer rediss://). May embed password. Secret. Unused for memory.

configurationParameters.label: Max Len
configurationParameters.description: Max queue length. Default 10000. Enqueue fails when full.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read / run budget in seconds. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Keep at or below the sandbox request budget. Example: 25.
